article_content: By Ray Massey. PUBLISHED: 13:22 EST, 20 March 2012 | UPDATED: 04:35 EST, 21 March 2012. The Japanese automaker Datsun, renowned for affordable and reliable vehicles, revolutionized the UK car market in the 1970s, accelerating the decline of British manufacturers. After rebranding as Nissan in the 1980s, the Datsun name is being revived as a budget brand. Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn recently announced plans for new compact, eco-friendly Datsun models launching in Indonesia, India, and Russia by 2014, emphasizing affordability and local production. During its 1970s UK peak, Datsun offered advanced features like heated rear windows and reclining seats at competitive prices—notably the £765 Cherry 100A and £2,389 240Z sports coupe. The brand was phased out by 1985, coinciding with Nissan's Sunderland factory opening in 1986. Industry analyst Jay Nagley highlighted Nissan's strategy to maintain brand value through separate low-cost lines, akin to Renault's Dacia. This follows Nissan's recent commitment to create 2,000 UK jobs for manufacturing the new 'Invitation' model in Sunderland.

Nadat hulle in die 1980's as Nissan hernoem is, word die Datsun-handelsmerk nou as 'n laekoste-reeks herleef. In hul 1970's suksesperiode in Brittanje het Datsun voertuie soos die £765 Cherry 100A en £2,389 240Z-sportkoepee aangebied met gevorderde kenmerke soos verhitte agterruite en verstelbare sitplekke. Die handelsmerk is in 1985 uitgefaseer, kort voor die opening van Nissan se Sunderland-fabriek in 1986. Bedryfskenner Jay Nagley het Nissan se strategie uitgelig om 'n laekoste-reeks te ontwikkel sonder om hul hoofhandelsmerk se beeld te skaad, soortgelyk aan Renault se Dacia. Dit volg op Nissan se onlangse aankondiging om 2 000 nuwe werksgeleenthede in die VK te skep vir die vervaardiging van die nuwe 'Invitation'-model in Sunderland.

article_content: When zoologist Dian Fossey - whose work inspired 'Gorillas in the Mist' - was killed in 1985, only 250 mountain gorillas remained in Africa's Virunga Mountains. Today, their numbers have doubled to over 500 thanks to the Gorilla Doctors she inspired. Established in 1986 as the Virunga Veterinary Center, this team of 16 veterinarians operates across DR Congo, Rwanda, and Uganda. They perform life-saving interventions, treating gorillas injured by poachers' snares or human-transmitted diseases. Using antibiotics and field surgeries, they've conducted over 150 medical procedures and rehabilitated 20 orphans requiring constant care. Team leader Dr. Mike Cranfield recounts close calls with protective silverbacks during treatments. Despite recent challenges from M23 rebel conflicts limiting park access, the doctors remain optimistic. Their £600,000 annual program aims to eventually reach 1,500 gorillas while training African veterinary experts. Current IUCN estimates show 1,063 mountain gorillas exist. Cranfield emphasizes gorillas' dual role as conservation symbols and economic assets for host nations.
translated_content: Toe dierkundige Dian Fossey - bekend van die fliek 'Gorillas in the Mist' - in 1985 vermoor is, was daar net 250 berggorillas in Afrika se Virunga-berge. Vandag het hul getalle verdubbel tot meer as 500, dank aan die Gorilla Doctors wat deur haar werk geïnspireer is. Hierdie span van 16 veeartse, wat in 1986 as die Virunga Veeartsenykundige Sentrum begin het, werk in die DRK, Rwanda en Uganda. Hulle red gorillas uit stroperstrikke, behandel siektes, en het al meer as 150 veldoperasies gedoen. Hulle het 20 weesgorillas opgeneem wat dag-en-nag sorg nodig het. Dr. Mike Cranfield, wat al 13 jaar die span lei, deel verhale van gevaarlike oomblikke met beskermende silverbacks. Selfs met die M23-rebellekonflik wat parkwerk bemoeilik, hou hulle hoop. Met 'n jaarlikse begroting van £600,000 mik hulle vir 1,500 gorillas, terwyl hulle plaaslike veeartse oplei. Volgens die IUCN is daar nou 1,063 berggorillas. Cranfield sê hulle is beide bewaringsimbole en ekonomiese aanwinsse vir Afrika.

article_content: Recent findings expose enduring gender inequities in Hollywood's film industry. The 2013 earnings analysis reveals male stars dominate pay scales, with Robert Downey Jr topping $75 million versus Angelina Jolie's $33 million. Of the 20 highest-paid actors (10 male/10 female), only Jolie and Jennifer Lawrence ranked among the top 15 earners overall. Age disparities persist - while male actors like 61-year-old Liam Neeson maintain high earnings, female stars face earlier career peaks. Sandra Bullock (49) stood as the oldest top-earning actress, compared to multiple male counterparts in their 50s and 60s. On-screen representation remains unbalanced: men claimed 71% of speaking roles, with female characters frequently portrayed in sexualized attire or situations. Behind the scenes, women occupied just 16% of key creative roles in 2013's top-grossing films. The study also notes increased sexualization of young actresses - depictions of teenage female nudity rose 33% since 2007. Ethnic minorities faced similar exclusion, with most films featuring less than 10% Black cast members. Lead researcher Prof Stacy Smith describes 'a representational roadblock' directly tied to leadership diversity.

Van die 20 topverdienende akteurs (10 manlik/10 vroulik) het net Jolie en Jennifer Lawrence in die algehele top 15 verskyn. Ouderdomsverskille speel 'n groter rol vir vroue - manlike sterre soos Liam Neeson (61) bly hoë verdienste haal, terwyl vroue vroeër in hul loopbane piek. Sandra Bullock (49) was die oudste topverdienende aktris, teenoor verskeie mans in hul 50s en 60s. Op die skerm het mans 71% van sprekende rolle ingeneem, met vroue dikwels in seksueel uitdagende kostuums. Agter die skerms het vroue net 16% van sleutelposisies in 2013 se suksesrolprente beklee. Daar was 'n 33% toename in uitbeeldings van tieneraktrisse se naaktheid sedert 2007. Swart akteurs was in minder as 10% van rolle in meeste films. Navorser Prof Stacy Smith praat van ''n verteenwoordigingsprobleem' wat aan leierskapdiversiteit gekoppel is.
